name: houston
description: Streams what each Claude Code agent is doing to Houston, the Mac app: sessions starting and ending, prompts, tool calls and how they ended, permission requests, notifications, subagents and stops; answers to its permission prompts from Houston's permission card; the progress tool, whose plans Houston shows with their time left; Houston's own tools, through houston mcp; Houston's browser as every session's browser; and artifacts kept on this Mac, when Houston's setting says so.
